label: Bible Study
prompt: _____ me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:
verse: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:
note: David closes his psalm on God's all-knowing presence by inviting the search.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And he blessed Joseph, and said, God, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the God which _____ me all my life long unto this day,
verse: And he blessed Joseph, and said, God, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the God which fed me all my life long unto this day,
note: Old Jacob blesses Joseph, calling God the one who fed him all his life long.

label: Sunday School
prompt: By faith he sojourned in the land of promise, as in a strange country, dwelling in _____ with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise:
verse: By faith he sojourned in the land of promise, as in a strange country, dwelling in tabernacles with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise:
note: Abraham lived in tents in the very land God had promised him — 'tabernacles' here simply means tents.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Blessed is the man that endureth _____: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.
verse: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.
note: James's beatitude for the tested: endure it, and there's a crown of life waiting at the end.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made _____:
verse: Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:
note: Some 'made shipwreck' of their faith — and Paul, who'd been shipwrecked three times (2 Corinthians 11:25), knew the image.
